newsitem.title: USA: Bay State to leave KBC Energy partnership.
newsitem.headline: Bay State to leave KBC Energy partnership.

text.p: Bay State Gas Co said Monday its affiliate, Bay State Energy Enterprises, will withdraw from KBC Energy Services by mutual agreement of its partners, CTG Resources Inc's unregulated subsidiary, The Energy Network, and Koch Gas Services Co.
CTG Resources and Koch Gas Services have acquired the partnership interest of Bay State's affiliate, Bay State said. The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Since the summer of 1995, KBC Energy Services has been engaged in marketing natural gas supplies and energy related services on an unregulated basis to residential, commercial and industrial end-users, primarily in New England, New Jersey and Long Island.
